mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at the Military Ridge State Trail and the temperature is 62 degrees.

The City of Verona Plan Commission is meeting on Monday, October 5th to review several development projects, and our community is also working through the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide our growth over the next decade.
Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, while tomorrow features the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli and the Dane County Farmers Market in downtown Madison.
In a strange incident on September 5th, police discovered a social media prank known as the Dairy Dare, where several vehicles around town were found with cheese slices on their windshields.
While Culver's is currently closed, they will be open today at 10:00 AM to satisfy your craving for the flavor of the day.
